verses.text: King David don old well well, e don reach old age, and dem cover am with cloth, but e no fit get warm.
So im servants talk to am say, “Make dem find one young virgin for my oga di king. Make e stand before di king and take care of am. Make e lie for your chest, so that my oga di king go get heat.”
So dem search for one beautiful young woman all over Israel land, and dem find Abishag wey come from Shunem, and dem bring am come meet di king.
Di young woman beautiful well well, and e take care of di king and serve am, but di king no sleep with am.
Adonijah, Haggith pikin, lift imself up talk say, “I go be king.” E prepare chariots and horsemen for imself, and 50 men to run before am.
Im papa never vex am at any time by asking am say, “Why you do so?” Adonijah too na very fine man, and dem born am after Absalom.
E talk with Joab, Zeruiah pikin, and with Abiathar di priest, and dem follow Adonijah and help am.
But Zadok di priest, Benaiah, Jehoiada pikin, Nathan di prophet, Shimei, Rei, and David strong men no join Adonijah.
Adonijah kill sheep, oxen and fat animals for Zoheleth stone, wey dey near En Rogel, and e call all im brothers, di king pikin dem, and all di men of Judah, di king servants.
But e no call Nathan di prophet, or Benaiah, or di strong men, or Solomon im brother.
Den Nathan talk to Bathsheba, Solomon mama, say, “You never hear say Adonijah, Haggith pikin, don become king, and David our oga no know?
So come make I give you advice, so that you go save your own life and your pikin Solomon life.
Go meet King David and tell am, ‘My oga di king, you no swear to your servant talk say, “Solomon your pikin go be king after me, and e go sit for my throne”? Why den Adonijah don become king?’
Look, as you still dey talk with di king there, I too go enter after you and confirm your words.”
So Bathsheba enter di king room. Di king don old well well, and Abishag wey come from Shunem dey serve am.
Bathsheba bow and show respect to di king. Di king talk say, “Wetin you want?”
E talk to am say, “My oga, you swear by di Lord your God to your servant say, ‘Solomon your pikin go be king after me, and e go sit for my throne.’
But look, Adonijah don become king, and you, my oga di king, no know.
E don kill oxen, fat animals and sheep plenty plenty, and e don call all di king pikin dem, and Abiathar di priest, and Joab di captain of di army, but e no call Solomon your servant.
As for you, my oga di king, all Israel eyes dey on you, make you tell dem who go sit for di throne of my oga di king after am.
If not, e go happen say, as my oga di king die and go sleep with im papa dem, dem go count me and my pikin Solomon as criminals.”
Look, as e still dey talk with di king, Nathan di prophet enter.
Dem tell di king say, “Nathan di prophet don come!” As e enter before di king, e bow with im face down to di ground.
Nathan talk say, “My oga di king, you don talk say, ‘Adonijah go be king after me, and e go sit for my throne’?

Because e don go down today, and e don kill oxen, fat animals and sheep plenty plenty, and e don call all di king pikin dem, and di army captains, and Abiathar di priest. Look, dem dey eat and drink before am, and dem dey talk say, ‘Make King Adonijah live long!’
But e no call me, even me your servant, and Zadok di priest, and Benaiah, Jehoiada pikin, and your servant Solomon.
Na my oga di king do dis thing, and you never show your servants who go sit for di throne of my oga di king after am?”
Den King David answer say, “Call Bathsheba make e come meet me.” E come before di king and stand before am.
Di king swear talk say, “As di Lord dey alive, wey don free my soul from all trouble,
as I swear to you by di Lord, di God of Israel, say, ‘Solomon your pikin go be king after me, and e go sit for my throne for my place,’ na so I go do am today for sure.”
Den Bathsheba bow with im face to di ground, show respect to di king and talk say, “Make my oga King David live forever!”
King David talk say, “Call Zadok di priest, Nathan di prophet, and Benaiah, Jehoiada pikin, make dem come meet me.” Dem come before di king.
Di king talk to dem say, “Take una oga servants go with una, and make Solomon my pikin ride my own mule, and bring am go down to Gihon.
Make Zadok di priest and Nathan di prophet anoint am there as king over Israel. Blow di trumpet and talk say, ‘Make King Solomon live long!’
Den una go follow am come up, and e go sit for my throne, because e go be king for my place, and I don choose am to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.”
Benaiah, Jehoiada pikin, answer di king say, “Amen! Make di Lord, di God of my oga di king, talk so too.
As di Lord don dey with my oga di king, na so make e dey with Solomon, and make im throne big pass di throne of my oga King David.”
So Zadok di priest, Nathan di prophet, Benaiah, Jehoiada pikin, di Cherethites and di Pelethites go down, dem make Solomon ride King David mule and bring am go Gihon.
Zadok di priest carry di horn of oil from di Tent and anoint Solomon. Dem blow di trumpet, and all di people talk say, “Make King Solomon live long!”
All di people follow am come up, dem dey play pipe and dey rejoice with big joy, so tay di ground shake because of dem sound.
Adonijah and all di guests wey dey with am hear am as dem finish to eat. As Joab hear di sound of di trumpet, e talk say, “Why di city dey make so much noise?”
As e still dey talk, look, Jonathan, Abiathar di priest pikin, come, and Adonijah talk say, “Enter, because na good man you be, and you dey bring good news.”
Jonathan answer Adonijah say, “Na true, our oga King David don make Solomon king.
Di king don send Zadok di priest, Nathan di prophet, Benaiah, Jehoiada pikin, di Cherethites and di Pelethites go with am, and dem don make am ride di king mule.
Zadok di priest and Nathan di prophet don anoint am king for Gihon. Dem don come up from there dey rejoice, so tay di city dey shake with noise. Na dis noise wey you hear.
Solomon don sit for di throne of di kingdom too.
Di king servants don come bless our oga King David, dey talk say, ‘Make your God make Solomon name better pass your name, and make im throne big pass your throne,’ and di king bow imself for di bed.
Di king talk dis one too, say, ‘Make dem bless di Lord, di God of Israel, wey don give one person to sit for my throne today, as my eyes dey see am.’”
All Adonijah guests fear, stand up, and each person go im way.
Adonijah fear because of Solomon, and e stand up, go and hold di horns of di altar.
Dem tell Solomon say, “Look, Adonijah dey fear King Solomon, and look, e don hold di horns of di altar, dey talk say, ‘Make King Solomon swear to me today say e no go kill im servant with sword.’”
Solomon talk say, “If e show say e be worthy man, no even one hair of am go fall to di ground, but if dem find wickedness for am, e go die.”
So King Solomon send people, and dem bring am down from di altar. E come bow to King Solomon, and Solomon talk to am say, “Go your house.”
As David time to die near, e command im pikin Solomon say,
“I dey go di way wey everybody for di earth go go. So be strong and show say you be man.

Keep wetin di Lord your God ask you to keep, to waka for im ways, to keep im laws, im commands, im rules and im instructions, as dem write am for Moses law, so that you go prosper for everything wey you do and for every place wey you turn go,

so that di Lord go make im word stand, di one wey e talk about me say, ‘If your pikin dem take care of dem way, to waka before me for truth with all dem heart and with all dem soul, no man go fail to sit for Israel throne.’

“You know too wetin Joab, Zeruiah pikin, do to me, even wetin e do to di two captains of Israel armies, Abner, Ner pikin, and Amasa, Jether pikin, wey e kill, and e shed di blood of war for time of peace, and e put di blood of war for im belt wey dey round im waist and for di sandals wey dey im feet.
So do as your wisdom tell you, and no let im grey head go down to Sheol in peace.

But show kindness to di pikin dem of Barzillai wey come from Gilead, and make dem dey among di people wey dey eat for your table, because na so dem take help me as I dey run from Absalom your brother.

“Look, Shimei, Gera pikin, wey be Benjamin man from Bahurim, dey with you. Na im curse me with bad curse for di day wey I dey go Mahanaim, but e come down meet me for Jordan, and I swear to am by di Lord say, ‘I no go kill you with sword.’
Now no count am as man wey no get guilt, because you be wise man, and you go know wetin you suppose do to am, and you go bring im grey head go down to Sheol with blood.”
David die join im papa dem, and dem bury am for David city.
Di days wey David rule Israel na 40 years. E rule seven years for Hebron, and e rule 33 years for Jerusalem.
Solomon sit for im papa David throne, and im kingdom stand strong well well.
Den Adonijah, Haggith pikin, come meet Bathsheba, Solomon mama. E ask am say, “You come in peace?” E answer say, “In peace.”
E talk again say, “I get something to tell you.” E talk say, “Talk am.”
E talk say, “You know say di kingdom na my own, and say all Israel don set dem face on me make I be king. But di kingdom don turn, e don become my brother own, because na from di Lord e come for am.
Now I dey ask you for one thing. No refuse me.” E talk to am say, “Talk am.”
E talk say, “Make you talk to King Solomon, because e no go tell you no, make e give me Abishag wey come from Shunem as wife.”
Bathsheba talk say, “Good. I go talk for you to di king.”

So Bathsheba go meet King Solomon to talk to am for Adonijah. Di king stand up to meet am, bow to am, sit down for im throne, and e make dem put one throne for di king mama, and e sit for im right hand.
Den e talk say, “I dey ask you for one small thing. No refuse me.” Di king talk to am say, “Ask am, my mama, because I no go refuse you.”
E talk say, “Make dem give Abishag wey come from Shunem to your brother Adonijah as wife.”

King Solomon answer im mama say, “Why you dey ask for Abishag wey come from Shunem for Adonijah? Ask for di kingdom for am too, because na my elder brother e be, even for am, and for Abiathar di priest, and for Joab, Zeruiah pikin.”
Den King Solomon swear by di Lord say, “Make God do me so, and more, if Adonijah no talk dis word against im own life.
Now as di Lord dey alive, wey don make me strong, wey put me for my papa David throne, and wey don make house for me as e promise, Adonijah go die today for sure.”
King Solomon send Benaiah, Jehoiada pikin, and e attack am so tay e die.

To Abiathar di priest di king talk say, “Go Anathoth, go your own farm, because you suppose die, but I no go kill you now, because you carry di ark of di Lord God before my papa David, and because you suffer for everything wey my papa suffer.”
So Solomon drive Abiathar comot from to be priest of di Lord, so that di word of di Lord wey e talk about Eli house for Shiloh go happen.
Di news reach Joab, because Joab don follow Adonijah, even though e no follow Absalom. Joab run go di Lord Tent, and hold di horns of di altar.
Dem tell King Solomon say, “Joab don run go di Lord Tent, and look, e dey by di altar.” Den Solomon send Benaiah, Jehoiada pikin, say, “Go, attack am.”

Benaiah come to di Lord Tent and talk to am say, “Di king talk say, ‘Come out.’” E talk say, “No, na here I go die.” Benaiah carry word go tell di king again say, “Na so Joab talk, and na so e answer me.”
Di king talk to am say, “Do as e talk, attack am and bury am, so that you go remove di innocent blood wey Joab shed from me and from my papa house.

Di Lord go return im blood on im own head, because e attack two men wey righteous pass am and better pass am, and e kill dem with sword, and my papa David no know: Abner, Ner pikin, captain of Israel army, and Amasa, Jether pikin, captain of Judah army.
So dem blood go return on Joab head and on im children head forever, but for David, and for im children, and for im house, and for im throne, peace go dey forever from di Lord.”
Den Benaiah, Jehoiada pikin, go up, attack am and kill am, and dem bury am for im own house for di wilderness.
Di king put Benaiah, Jehoiada pikin, for im place over di army, and di king put Zadok di priest for Abiathar place.
Di king send call Shimei and talk to am say, “Build house for yourself for Jerusalem, and stay there, and no go out from there to anywhere.
Because for di day wey you go out and cross Kidron stream, know for sure say you go die. Your blood go dey on your own head.”
Shimei talk to di king say, “Di word good. As my oga di king talk, na so your servant go do.” Shimei stay for Jerusalem plenty days.
E happen after three years say two of Shimei servants run go meet Achish, Maacah pikin, king of Gath. Dem tell Shimei say, “Look, your servants dey Gath.”
Shimei stand up, put saddle on im donkey, and go Gath meet Achish to look for im servants. Shimei go, and e bring im servants come from Gath.
Dem tell Solomon say Shimei don go from Jerusalem to Gath, and e don come back.

Di king send call Shimei and talk to am say, “I no make you swear by di Lord, and warn you say, ‘Know for sure say for di day wey you go out and waka go anywhere, you go die’? You talk to me say, ‘Di word wey I hear good.’
Why den you no keep di oath of di Lord, and di command wey I give you?”
Di king talk to Shimei again say, “You know all di wickedness wey your heart know, wey you do to my papa David. So di Lord go return your wickedness on your own head.
But King Solomon go get blessing, and David throne go stand before di Lord forever.”
So di king command Benaiah, Jehoiada pikin, and e go out and attack am, so tay e die. Di kingdom stand strong for Solomon hand.

Solomon make agreement with Pharaoh king of Egypt by marriage, and e marry Pharaoh daughter and bring am enter David city, until e finish to build im own house, and di Lord house, and di wall round Jerusalem.
Only di people dey make sacrifice for di high places, because dem never build house for di Lord name reach dat time.
Solomon love di Lord, and e dey waka for im papa David laws, only e dey make sacrifice and burn incense for di high places.
Di king go Gibeon to make sacrifice there, because na di big high place be dat. Solomon offer 1,000 burnt sacrifice for dat altar.
For Gibeon di Lord appear to Solomon for dream for night, and God talk say, “Ask wetin I go give you.”

Solomon talk say, “You don show your servant, my papa David, big mercy, as e waka before you for truth, for righteousness and for good heart with you, and you don keep dis big mercy for am, say you give am pikin to sit for im throne, as e be today.
Now, di Lord my God, you don make your servant king for my papa David place, and I be small pikin; I no know how to go out or come in.
Your servant dey among your people wey you choose, big people wey nobody fit count because dem plenty.
So give your servant heart wey get understanding to judge your people, so that I go fit know between good and evil, because who fit judge dis your big people?”
Di word please di Lord, say Solomon ask for dis thing.

God talk to am say, “Because you ask for dis thing, and you no ask for long life for yourself, and you no ask for riches for yourself, and you no ask for di life of your enemies, but you ask for understanding to know wetin be justice for yourself,
look, I don do as you talk. Look, I don give you wise heart wey get understanding, so tay nobody like you dey before you, and nobody go rise like you after you.
I don give you wetin you no ask too, both riches and honor, so that nobody among di kings go be like you all your days.
If you go waka for my ways, to keep my laws and my commands, as your papa David waka, den I go make your days long.”
Solomon wake up, and look, na dream. E come Jerusalem, stand before di ark of di covenant of di Lord, offer burnt sacrifice, offer peace sacrifice, and make feast for all im servants.
Den two women wey be prostitutes come meet di king and stand before am.
One woman talk say, “Oh, my oga, I and dis woman dey stay for one house, and I born pikin with am for di house.
Di third day after I born, dis woman born pikin too, and we dey together. Stranger no dey with us for di house, na only we two dey di house.
Dis woman pikin die for night, because e lie on am.
E stand up for midnight and take my pikin from my side as your servant dey sleep, and put am for im chest, and put im dead pikin for my chest.
As I wake up for morning to give my pikin breast, look, e don die. But as I look am well for morning, look, e no be my pikin wey I born.”

Di other woman talk say, “No, but di one wey dey alive na my pikin, and di dead one na your pikin.” Di first woman talk say, “No, but di dead one na your pikin, and di one wey dey alive na my pikin.” So dem talk before di king.

Den di king talk say, “One dey talk say, ‘Dis one wey dey alive na my pikin, and your pikin na di dead one,’ and di other dey talk say, ‘No, but your pikin na di dead one, and my pikin na di one wey dey alive.’”
Di king talk say, “Bring sword come meet me.” Dem bring sword before di king.
Di king talk say, “Cut di pikin wey dey alive into two, and give half to one and half to di other.”

Den di woman wey di pikin wey dey alive belong to talk to di king, because im heart pain am for im pikin, and e talk say, “Oh, my oga, give am di pikin wey dey alive, and no kill am at all.” But di other talk say, “E no go be mine or yours. Cut am.”
Den di king answer say, “Give di first woman di pikin wey dey alive, and no kill am at all. Na im be di mama.”
All Israel hear di judgment wey di king judge, and dem fear di king, because dem see say God wisdom dey inside am to do justice.
King Solomon be king over all Israel.
Dis na di leaders wey e get: Azariah, Zadok pikin, di priest;
Elihoreph and Ahijah, Shisha pikin dem, di secretaries; Jehoshaphat, Ahilud pikin, di record keeper;
and Benaiah, Jehoiada pikin, dey over di army; and Zadok and Abiathar be priests;
and Azariah, Nathan pikin, dey over di officers; and Zabud, Nathan pikin, be chief minister and di king friend;
and Ahishar dey over di house; and Adoniram, Abda pikin, dey over di men wey dey do forced work.
Solomon get 12 officers over all Israel, wey dey provide food for di king and im house. Each man suppose provide food for one month for di year.
Dis na dem names: Ben Hur, for Ephraim hill country;
Ben Deker, for Makaz, and for Shaalbim, and Beth Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan;
Ben Hesed, for Arubboth, Socoh and all Hepher land belong to am;
Ben Abinadab, for all Dor high place, e get Taphath, Solomon pikin, as wife;
Baana, Ahilud pikin, for Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean wey dey beside Zarethan, under Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, reach di other side of Jokmeam;
Ben Geber, for Ramoth Gilead, Jair town dem, Manasseh pikin, wey dey Gilead belong to am; di Argob region wey dey Bashan belong to am too, 60 big cities with wall and bronze bars;
Ahinadab, Iddo pikin, for Mahanaim;
Ahimaaz, for Naphtali, e marry Basemath, Solomon pikin, as wife too;
Baana, Hushai pikin, for Asher and Bealoth;
Jehoshaphat, Paruah pikin, for Issachar;
Shimei, Ela pikin, for Benjamin;
Geber, Uri pikin, for Gilead land, di country of Sihon king of di Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and na only im be di officer wey dey di land.
Judah and Israel plenty like sand wey dey by di sea, dem dey eat and drink and dey happy.
Solomon rule all di kingdoms from di River go reach di Philistines land, and reach Egypt border. Dem bring tribute and serve Solomon all di days of im life.
Solomon food for one day na 30 measures of fine flour and 60 measures of meal,
ten fat cattle, and 20 cattle from di grass land, and 100 sheep, apart from deer, and gazelles, and roebucks, and fat birds.
Because e get power over everything for dis side of di River, from Tiphsah reach Gaza, over all di kings for dis side of di River, and e get peace for all sides round am.
Judah and Israel dey stay safe, every man under im vine and under im fig tree, from Dan reach Beersheba, all di days of Solomon.
Solomon get 40,000 stalls of horses for im chariots, and 12,000 horsemen.
Dem officers dey provide food for King Solomon, and for all wey dey come to King Solomon table, every man for im month. Dem no let anything lack.
Dem bring barley and straw too for di horses and fast horses go di place wey di officers dey, every man as im work be.
God give Solomon wisdom and very big understanding, and wide heart, like di sand wey dey di seashore.
Solomon wisdom pass di wisdom of all di people for di east, and all di wisdom of Egypt.
Because e wise pass all men, pass Ethan wey come from Ezrah, and Heman, and Calcol, and Darda, Mahol pikin dem. And im name reach all di nations round.
E talk 3,000 proverbs, and im songs na 1,005.
E talk about trees, from di cedar wey dey Lebanon reach di hyssop wey dey grow out of di wall. E talk about animals too, and birds, and things wey dey crawl, and fish.
People from all nations come to hear Solomon wisdom, from all di kings of di earth wey hear about im wisdom.
Hiram king of Tyre send im servants to Solomon, because e hear say dem don anoint am king for im papa place, because Hiram dey always love David.
Solomon send go tell Hiram say,
“You know say my papa David no fit build house for di name of di Lord im God because of di wars wey dey round am for every side, until di Lord put dem under im feet.
But now di Lord my God don give me rest for every side. Enemy no dey, and bad thing no dey happen.
Look, I wan build house for di name of di Lord my God, as di Lord talk to my papa David say, ‘Your pikin wey I go put for your throne for your place, na im go build di house for my name.’

So now command say make dem cut cedar trees for me from Lebanon. My servants go dey with your servants, and I go pay your servants wage as you talk, because you know say nobody dey among us wey know how to cut wood like di Sidonians.”
As Hiram hear Solomon words, e rejoice well well and talk say, “Make dem bless di Lord today, wey give David wise pikin over dis big people.”
Hiram send go tell Solomon say, “I don hear di message wey you send to me. I go do all wetin you want about cedar wood and cypress wood.

My servants go bring dem down from Lebanon go di sea, and I go make dem into rafts to go by sea go di place wey you go show me, and I go make dem break dem there, and you go receive dem. And you go do wetin I want, to give food to my house.”
So Hiram give Solomon cedar wood and cypress wood as e want.
Solomon give Hiram 20,000 measures of wheat for food for im house, and 20 measures of pure oil. Na so Solomon dey give Hiram year by year.
Di Lord give Solomon wisdom as e promise am, and peace dey between Hiram and Solomon, and di two of dem make treaty together.
King Solomon gather workers from all Israel, and di workers na 30,000 men.
E send dem go Lebanon, 10,000 each month by turns. Dem dey stay one month for Lebanon and two months for house. Adoniram dey over di men wey dey do forced work.
Solomon get 70,000 wey dey carry load and 80,000 wey dey cut stone for di mountains,
apart from Solomon chief officers wey dey over di work, 3,300, wey dey rule di people wey dey labor for di work.
Di king command, and dem cut big stones, costly stones, to lay di foundation of di house with stone wey dem don shape.
Solomon builders and Hiram builders and di men of Gebal cut dem, and dem prepare di wood and di stones to build di house.
E happen for di 480th year after Israel pikin dem comot from Egypt land, for di fourth year of Solomon rule over Israel, for di month Ziv, wey be di second month, say e begin to build di Lord house.
Di house wey King Solomon build for di Lord, im length na 60 cubits, and im width na 20 cubits, and im height na 30 cubits.
Di porch for front of di temple of di house, im length na 20 cubits, as di width of di house be, and im width na ten cubits for front of di house.
For di house e make windows with fixed lattice work.
Against di wall of di house e build rooms in stories round am, against di walls of di house round am, both di temple and di inner sanctuary, and e make side rooms round am.

Di lowest story na five cubits wide, and di middle one na six cubits wide, and di third one na seven cubits wide, because for outside e make steps for di wall of di house round am, so that di beams no go hold inside di walls of di house.
As dem dey build di house, dem build am with stone wey dem don prepare before dem bring am go there, so hammer or axe or any iron tool no dey hear for di house as dem dey build am.
Di door for di middle side rooms dey di right side of di house, and dem dey go up with winding stairs enter di middle story, and from di middle go di third.
So e build di house and finish am, and e cover di house with beams and planks of cedar.
E build di stories against all di house, each one five cubits high, and dem rest on di house with cedar wood.
Di word of di Lord come to Solomon say,
“About dis house wey you dey build, if you go waka for my laws, and do my rules, and keep all my commands to waka for dem, den I go make my word stand with you, di one wey I talk to your papa David.
I go stay among Israel pikin dem, and I no go leave my people Israel.”
So Solomon build di house and finish am.
E build di walls of di house inside with cedar boards. From di floor of di house reach di walls of di ceiling, e cover dem inside with wood, and e cover di floor of di house with cypress boards.
E build 20 cubits for di back part of di house with cedar boards from di floor reach di walls. E build dem for am inside as inner sanctuary, even di Most Holy Place.
Di house, wey be di temple for front of di inner sanctuary, na 40 cubits long.
Cedar dey di house inside, dem carve am with buds and open flowers. Everything na cedar, no stone dey show.
E prepare inner sanctuary inside di house, to put di ark of di covenant of di Lord there.
Di inner sanctuary inside na 20 cubits long, and 20 cubits wide, and 20 cubits high. E cover am with pure gold, and e cover di altar with cedar.
So Solomon cover di house inside with pure gold, and e stretch gold chains across for front of di inner sanctuary, and e cover am with gold.
E cover di whole house with gold until all di house finish. E cover di whole altar wey belong to di inner sanctuary with gold too.
For di inner sanctuary e make two cherubim with olive wood, each one na ten cubits high.
Five cubits na di one wing of di cherub, and five cubits na di other wing of di cherub. From di end of one wing to di end of di other na ten cubits.
Di other cherub na ten cubits. Di two cherubim get di same size and di same shape.
Di height of one cherub na ten cubits, and na so di other cherub too.

E put di cherubim inside di inner house. Di wings of di cherubim dey stretch out, so tay di wing of one touch one wall, and di wing of di other cherub touch di other wall, and dem wings touch each other for di middle of di house.
E cover di cherubim with gold.
E carve all di walls of di house round with carved figures of cherubim and palm trees and open flowers, inside and outside.
E cover di floor of di house with gold, inside and outside.
For di entrance of di inner sanctuary e make doors with olive wood. Di top frame and di door posts na one fifth of di wall.
So e make two doors with olive wood, and e carve cherubim and palm trees and open flowers on dem, and e cover dem with gold, and e spread di gold on di cherubim and on di palm trees.
Na so e make for di entrance of di temple door posts with olive wood, na one fourth of di wall,
and two doors with cypress wood. Di two parts of one door fold, and di two parts of di other door fold.
E carve cherubim and palm trees and open flowers on dem, and e cover dem with gold wey fit well for di carved work.
E build di inner court with three rows of shaped stone and one row of cedar beams.
For di fourth year dem lay di foundation of di Lord house, for di month Ziv.
